title_en: Well, the Greek Prime Minister Seems Happy With The Odyssey — He Called Christopher Nolan to Thank Him for Boosting Interest in Ancient Greek Civilization
cn_title: 希腊总理致电克里斯托弗·诺兰赞《奥德赛》
subtitle: 古希腊热潮
summary: 希腊总理Kyriakos Mitsotakis致电克里斯托弗·诺兰，称《奥德赛》提升了全球对古希腊文化的兴趣。影片票房强劲，但译者Emily Wilson批评其改编混乱、糟糕；争议仍围绕选角、盔甲与当代口音展开。
opus_summary: 希腊总理致电克里斯托弗·诺兰，感谢《奥德赛》带动全球关注古希腊文化，也肯定影片在希腊取景。影片票房强劲，却因改编、选角和现代口音持续引发争议。

paragraphs.en: The Greek prime minister called Christpher Nolan to personally congratulate him for The Odyssey , which he said has boosted interest in ancient Greek culture.
paragraphs.cn: 希腊总理致电克里斯托弗·诺兰，亲自祝贺《奥德赛》，并称该片提升了人们对古希腊文化的兴趣。

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis spoke to Nolan on Monday afternoon via video call, congratulating him for his adaptation of the Homeric epic poem and thanking him for the film's contribution to “stimulating global interest in ancient Greek culture,” a press release from the PM’s office reads . The note added that “such productions bridge Greece's rich cultural heritage with contemporary creativity.”
paragraphs.cn: 总理Kyriakos Mitsotakis周一下午通过视频通话与诺兰交谈，祝贺他改编荷马史诗，并感谢这部电影为「激发全球对古希腊文化的兴趣」所作的贡献，总理办公室的新闻稿如此写道。新闻稿还称，「这类作品连接了希腊丰富的文化遗产与当代创意。」

paragraphs.en: Mitsotakis also spoke about The Odyssey’s huge box office success, and “expressed his appreciation for the fact that a significant part of the filming took place in Greece.” Parts of the movie were shot in the Peloponnese region of Greece, including Voidokilia Beach, the 13th-century Methoni Castle, the monolithic Acrocorinth overlooking the city of Corinth, Almyrolaka Beach, and Nestor’s Cave.
paragraphs.cn: Mitsotakis还谈到《奥德赛》在票房上的巨大成功，并「赞赏影片有相当一部分在希腊取景」。电影部分场景在希腊伯罗奔尼撒地区拍摄，包括Voidokilia海滩、13世纪的Methoni城堡、俯瞰科林斯城的巨岩卫城Acrocorinth、Almyrolaka海滩和涅斯托耳洞穴。

paragraphs.en: Mitsotakis’ conversation with Nolan comes hot on the heels of a scathing review of The Odyssey by Greek translator and University of Pennsylvania professor Emily Wilson , who called Nolan’s film a "confused" and "abysmal" adaptation of Homer's text.
paragraphs.cn: Mitsotakis与诺兰的这次交谈，紧随希腊译者、宾夕法尼亚大学教授Emily Wilson对《奥德赛》的一篇严厉影评之后；她称诺兰的电影是对荷马文本一次「混乱」且「糟糕透顶」的改编。

paragraphs.en: The Odyssey is a smash hit with critics and on course to make over $1 billion at the global box office , but some have questioned changes made by Nolan for his adaptation of Homer's epic poem.
paragraphs.cn: 《奥德赛》大受影评人欢迎，全球票房有望超过10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)；但也有人质疑诺兰为改编荷马史诗所作的改动。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for The Odyssey follow:
paragraphs.cn: 警告：下文含《奥德赛》剧透。

paragraphs.en: Wilson, who is behind the 2017 translation of The Odyssey that Nolan reportedly credited with inspiring his take on the poem, , and called the film’s anti-war and anti-cowardice message “incoherent.” She was also critical of Anne Hathaway’s Penelope, saying the role was so reduced it endangered “any possibility of believing in this marriage.” Neither did she like the scenes with Odysseus' dog, Argos, which she said “catered towards modern sentimentality.” Overall, Wilson said she thought Nolan “was trying to pack everything in while missing themes that were essential to the poem.”
paragraphs.cn: 2017年《奥德赛》译本的译者Emily Wilson表示，诺兰据称曾称该译本启发他改编这首史诗；她则认为电影反战、反怯懦的信息「前后不一」。她还批评安妮·海瑟薇饰演的佩内洛普，认为这个角色被削弱得太厉害，已经危及「让人相信这段婚姻存在的任何可能」。她也不喜欢奥德修斯的狗阿尔戈斯的戏，称那些场景「迎合现代人的多愁善感」。总体而言，Wilson认为诺兰「试图塞进所有内容，却遗漏了这首诗中至关重要的主题」。

paragraphs.en: In a recent interview with Time Magazine , Nolan explained some of his changes around Helen of Troy, Athena, and his new ending — although he still left much to audience interpretation.
paragraphs.cn: 诺兰最近接受《时代》杂志采访时，解释了他对特洛伊的海伦、雅典娜及新结局所作的部分调整，但仍给观众留下很大的解读空间。

paragraphs.en: Last week, Elon Musk claimed that Grok would make an AI movie of The Odyssey “that is historically accurate and true to the art of Homer,” by the end of 2026, although he did not make any claim about whether it would be any good.
paragraphs.cn: 上周，埃隆·马斯克宣称，Grok将在2026年底前制作一部「符合历史事实、忠于荷马艺术」的《奥德赛》AI电影，但他没有声称影片质量会如何。

paragraphs.en: Musk's comment came as little surprise, given the X and Tesla owner was a vocal critic of Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey in the run up to its release in theaters. Much of the online backlash, such as it is, revolved around conservative complaints that Nolan's The Odyssey would be “woke” for starring transgender actor Elliot Page (Sinon), rapper Travis Scott (the Bard), and black actress Lupita Nyong'o (Helen of Troy and her sister, Clytemnestra).
paragraphs.cn: 马斯克的评论并不令人意外，因为这位X和特斯拉的所有者在《奥德赛》院线上映前就一直尖锐批评克里斯托弗·诺兰的电影。尽管线上反弹声势有限，其中许多集中于保守派的批评：诺兰的《奥德赛》由跨性别演员Elliot Page（饰演Sinon）、说唱歌手Travis Scott（饰演吟游诗人）和黑人女演员尼永奥（饰演特洛伊的海伦及其姐姐Clytemnestra）主演，因此会显得「觉醒」。

paragraphs.en: “This is a mythological story,” Nyong’o said in May . “I’m very supportive of Chris’ intention with it and with the version of this story that he is telling. Our cast is representative of the world. I’m not spending my time thinking of a defense. The criticism will exist whether I engage with it or not.”
paragraphs.cn: 尼永奥今年5月表示：「这是一个神话故事。我非常支持诺兰的创作意图，也支持他所讲述的这个版本。我们的演员阵容代表了这个世界。我不会花时间为此辩护。无论我是否回应，批评都会存在。」

paragraphs.en: She added: “It’s quite something to be a part of The Odyssey, because it is so grand. It spans worlds. So that’s why the cast is what it is. We’re occupying the epic narrative of our time.”
paragraphs.cn: 她补充道：「能够参与《奥德赛》很不寻常，因为它规模宏大、跨越多个世界。这就是演员阵容如此安排的原因。我们正在演绎属于这个时代的史诗叙事。」

paragraphs.en: Ahead of release, The Odyssey was debated across the internet for its casting choices , some of its armor design , and the decision to have its characters speak with contemporary dialogue and in mostly modern American accents .
paragraphs.cn: 影片上映前，《奥德赛》的选角、部分盔甲设计，以及让角色以当代对白和大多带现代美国口音的方式说话的决定，都在网上引发讨论。

paragraphs.en: Prof Daniel Mendelsohn, whose translation of Homer's poem was published last year, said at the UK's Hay Festival in May that he was amused by "all of these bros suddenly worrying about Greek literature". According to a report in The Telegraph , Mendelsohn said: "What's so funny is that Helen has the tiniest role in The Odyssey… so the debate is particularly silly."
paragraphs.cn: Daniel Mendelsohn教授翻译的荷马史诗版本于去年出版。他今年5月在英国Hay Festival表示，看到「这些老兄突然开始担心希腊文学」，自己觉得很有趣。据《每日电讯报》报道，Mendelsohn说：「好笑的是，海伦在《奥德赛》里的戏份少得可怜……所以这场争论格外荒唐。」
